In CNIL’s practical AI guidance sheets, age information should be handled by prioritizing the least intrusive format without losing relevant information for the intended purpose. For example, it is recommended to use age or age ranges instead of complete birth dates.

In the context of a diagnosis-aid system, the guidance suggests that generalizing age information can significantly reduce the risk of loss of confidentiality. This could involve representing age in broader terms, such as using [month-year] or [year] instead of [day-month-year]. This approach helps to protect personal data while still allowing the system to function effectively.
